Palawan, 27 to 31 Dec: pick our adventure

4 ways to spend the 4 days between Manila and Boracay New Year's Eve, each scored on real review data, with proven reviews and a proven lively group counting most. My pick is now the Coron → El Nido boat trip 🚤: it's the best reviewed and has the most proven social groups.

🧮 How we scored

Six metrics, each from 1 to 5 dots, with the same thresholds for every option. Every number was checked on 28 Sep 2026.

⚖️ The weighting (your top two criteria count ×3)
⭐ Review strength ×3🎉 Social ×3🏝️ Scenery ×1😴 Sleep ×1🛟 Logistics ×1💰 Value ×1
Weighted score = Σ (dots × weight), out of 50. Proven reviews + a proven social group = 30 of the 50 points. The unweighted /30 total is shown too.
🔍1 · CollectRatings and counts from Tripadvisor, Google Maps, Booking.com, Hostelworld, GetYourGuide and the operators' own sites.
🧪2 · SampleThe latest 30–60 reviews for each place (49 for the boat operator), coded for social, sleep, crew and weather.
📏3 · Apply the keyThresholds below, then weight them. Proxy data is shown but never scored.

🎉 Social
Checklist: 1 point for each tick (minimum score 1). Only reviews of this exact trip or stay count.
  • Shared group: the same people for the days (not just a hostel)
  • Nightly group events (bonfire, socials, games)
  • ≥30% of sampled reviews praise the group, people or vibe
  • Age fit: ≥25% of reviewers aged 31+, or reviewers describe a mixed-age crowd
  • <10% of sampled reviews say quiet, dead or too young
  • −1 if fewer than 4 people are booked when last checked
×30–1 points2 points3 points4 points5 points
🏝️ Scenery
What you actually see, based on the route.
×1Mostly transitBeach or land only, no boat days1 boat day on the busy El Nido circuit + beach days2–3 days in remote waters, but the route is new or has fewer boat days3 days at sea through Linapacan/Culion with remote camps, on a route past guests have reviewed
😴 Sleep
Bed quality and heat. December nights are about 24–27°C.
×1No bedding, or no dataShared beach tents with mats, or dorms; or heat/noise complaints ≥15%Beach nipa huts with bedding and nets, no air-con; complaints <10%Private glamping tent or room with fans; heat complaints <15%Private air-con room or tent, and reviews praise the air-con
🛟 Logistics risk
More dots = safer. Start at 5 and lose 1 for each red flag: ① new or unreviewed operator/route ② needs an extra flight or gives up a booked one ③ open-water crossing exposed to the December north-east monsoon (amihan) ④ seats or minimum numbers unconfirmed ⑤ less than 18 hours before a flight.
×14+ flags3 flags2 flags1 flag0 flags
⭐ Review strength
Across platforms; /10 scores are halved to /5. A score of 4+ needs reviews from the last 12 months. If the exact trip has no reviews it scores 1: operator-wide reviews are shown but not counted.
×3<10 reviews10–49 reviews, or average <4.250+ reviews averaging ≥4.2200+ reviews averaging ≥4.51,000+ reviews averaging ≥4.7 on 2+ platforms
💰 Value
Midpoint of the all-in A$ per person (tour, transfers, rooms, flight changes). +1 if at least 2 days are fully catered (meals and drinks included). Maximum 5.
×1over A$1,050A$901–1,050A$751–900A$551–750A$550 or less

Only evidence about the exact trip or stay counts. Proxy data (for example, El Nido Paradise's Coron route for the new Port Barton route) is shown in the evidence panels, clearly labelled PROXY, but it is never scored. The review samples are the latest reviews we could reach on each platform, coded by keyword and then checked by hand. Only English keywords were matched, so a few reviews in other languages may be undercounted.

1 · Port Barton21
Weighted evidence score out of 50 (reviews and social ×3)

New pick: ⭐ Option 2, Coron → El Nido. It is the only option that is proven on both of our top criteria: 3,400+ operator-wide reviews at 4.8–4.9, plus groups of about 15, with 39% of sampled reviews praising the group and none calling it quiet. It scores 43/50. The cost: we give up the booked PPS flight (~A$93 each), add a Clark → Coron flight, and the crossing is more exposed. Seats still need confirming.

Runner-up: Option 3 (38). It is well reviewed and the safest, but the social side is hostel-based and skews young (only 20% of Outpost reviewers are 31+). If we choose it, pick Nacpan Beach Glamping over Mad Monkey.

Option 1 drops to last (21). Scored on its own evidence, the new route has 0 reviews and an unproven group. It's still the best fit for our flights, and the Coron-route proxy looks good, but proxies don't count here. Option A (22) is still not recommended.
